description: Replaces the text of one network's version of a post with the maker's own edit, like typing in upTake's Write studio. Free: no AI, no quota. Refused for a version already published or scheduled, and when the new text drops the tracked link. To rewrite with AI, use uptake_write_post.

network.description: Which version to edit: the network of one of the post's versions (see uptake_get_post).

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

text.description: The full new text of that version, as it will be posted. Keep its tracked link.

name: uptake_edit_post
title: Edit a post
